name: cache-clock
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm as a countdown above the prompt, with an optional keep-warm mode.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto picks 1 hour for subscriptions and 5 minutes for API keys. Set 5m or 1h to override.

keepWarm.title: Keep warm at start
keepWarm.description: Start each session with keep-warm on. It sends a tiny request before the cache expires, which costs a cache read of your whole context each time.

marginSeconds.title: Keep-warm margin (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: Send the keep-warm request this many seconds before the cache expires.

maxPings.title: Max keep-warm requests
maxPings.description: Stop keeping warm after this many requests in a row with no activity from you.
